sentences.text:
The prayer for bail of the petitioner was rejected by the learned Addl. Sessions Judge -cum -Special Judge, Jajpur vide order dated 07.06.2021.
// 2 // Learned counsel for the petitioner has produced the certified copy of the deposition of the victim, who has been examined as P.W.1.

On perusal of the statement of the victim, it appears that the victim has supported the prosecution case and stated about the gang rape committed on her and more specifically, she identified the petitioner to be one of the culprits.

In view of the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim implicating the petitioner in the commission of gang rape and the nature and gravity of accusation, I am not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
The prayer for bail stands rejected.
The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.

( S.K. Sahoo) Judge Sipun Silu @ Umesh Chandra vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101855824/
